expected.method: The 92-face flanged spool is symmetric across y = 0, so subtracting the half-space box y >= 0 leaves half of the exact spool volume V_full / 2. On z in [0, 128] the outer revolved profile consists of four 45-deg frusta r = 64 <-> 65 of height 1 (4 * pi/3 * (64^2 + 64*65 + 65^2)), two flange cylinders r = 65 of height 3 (2 * pi * 65^2 * 3), one barrel cylinder r = 35 of height 83 (pi * 35^2 * 83), three concave quarter-tori (R0 = 45, rho = 10, each pi * (45^2 * 10 - pi/2 * 45 * 10^2 + 2000/3)) and one neck concave quarter-torus (R0 = 40, rho = 5, pi * (40^2 * 5 - pi/2 * 40 * 25 + 250/3)), less the bore r = 31 of height 128 and 24 bolt holes r = 4 of height 5. On z in [128, 140] the 6-lobe scalloped flange (6 convex arcs R1 = 10 - delta at R = 45 and 6 tangent concave arcs R2 = 40 + delta, exact quadratic in delta integrated over [128, 129], [129, 139], [139, 140]) less the stepped bore (r = 31 on [128, 130], r = 35 on [130, 140]) and 6 countersunk holes (r = 5 on [128, 139], frustum 5 -> 6 on [139, 140]) gives V_full = 248052.0320278483 mm^3, hence V_full / 2 = 124026.01601392415 mm^3.
